newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jardine close to Pakistan JV, bourse membership.
newsitem.headline: Jardine close to Pakistan JV, bourse membership.

text.p: Jardine Fleming Holdings Ltd said on Monday its Jardine Fleming Pakistan Broking (Private) Ltd was close to reaching a joint venture deal with a Pakistan partner and membership of the Karachi Stock Exchange should follow.

"The authorisation for membership of the Karachi Stock Exchange has been deferred until Jardine Fleming Pakistan Broking (can) identify a joint venture partner for their operations in Pakistan as required by the authorities," Jardine Fleming spokesman Rodney Williams said.
"We are in discussions with certain entities with regard to one of them becoming our joint venture partner," Williams said, adding that he expected a deal to be reached in the "near future".
"When we identify our joint venture partner our membership will flow through more or less immediately," Williams said.
Jardine Fleming also said it had declined to accept the resignation of Tariq Jamal, a director and the head of broking at Jardine Fleming Pakistan Broking.
Williams said Jamal had tendered his resignation following "an anonymous allegation" concerning his eduational qualifications.
"This in no way concerns the validity of our application for stock exchange membership and the Karachi Stock Exchange views this purely as an internal affair," Williams said.
Jardine Fleming said in a statement that Jamal would be suspended on full salary "pending the outcome of extensive further investigations by Jardine to clarify all aspects of this situation."

Jamal had been proposed as Jardine Fleming Pakistan's nominee director in Jardine's application for a seat on the Karachi Stock Exchange and Williams said another director had now been put forward as nominee.
